# WALLS.md — frozen per-model evaluation walls (Exp 2)

*Generated by src/04_freeze_walls.py from the archived probe battery ONLY — no
factor-performance data touched. Rule (ex ante, README §1.5): wall = max(reported
cutoff, last month with LAP ≥ 0.5) + 3-month margin. LAP = P(higher)+P(lower)
from the first answer token's top-5 logprobs (Gao–Jiang–Yan). The git commit of
this file freezes the walls; evaluation may only use months STRICTLY AFTER the wall.*

## Evaluation windows implied (data ends: OSAP 2024-12, JKP ~2025-12, French 2026-05)
- gpt-4-0613 (wall 2022-04): **2022-05 → 2024-12 on OSAP (32 months)**, longer on JKP/French.
- gpt-4o-2024-08-06 (wall 2024-01): 2024-02 → 2024-12 on OSAP (11 months), ~23 on JKP.
- gpt-4.1-2025-04-14 (wall 2025-02): **OSAP window EMPTY** — evaluate on JKP/French only
  (~10 months); the panel's power rests on gpt-4-0613, as designed.

Noteworthy for the paper: two isolated post-reported-cutoff LAP spikes (gpt-4-0613 at
2022-01, correct answer; gpt-4.1 at 2024-11) — direct evidence, from our own instrument,
that effective cutoffs exceed reported ones (Cheng et al.'s caveat, measured here).
